_why: Figure 5.3 'INDIA - Major Forest Types' carries this chapter's only map of where each forest type occurs, and it is vector art the text layer cannot see. Note what it does NOT carry: it labels no States at all, only coloured bands plus 'Hot Desert' and 'Cold Desert'. Region answers must therefore describe position on the map, not name States.
